job.location: Various School Sites in Newport Beach and Costa Mesa, CA

items.item_text: 01. Information I provide in the following supplemental questions will be reviewed as part of the application process. Questions that are not fully and completely answered will be considered grounds for disqualification from the examination process. Stating "see resume" in lieu of a complete response to these questions is not acceptable. Select "Yes" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes

02. I understand that this recruitment will be used to fill Substitute Custodian positions ONLY , and that positions will be filled on a temporary/as-needed basis. Select "YES" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes

03. I understand that Substitute Custodians will be used to fill Day Shifts (6:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.), Midday Shifts (10:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.), Evening Shifts (2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.), and Part-Time Shifts (10:15 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.) on a temporary, as needed basis throughout the district, during the school year. I am willing to be considered for the following positions (Select All That Apply) : Options: I am willing to be considered for Day Shift (6:30 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.) | I am willing to be considered for Midday Shift (10:30 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.) | I am willing to be considered for Evening Shift (2:30 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.) | I am willing to be considered for Part-time Shift (10:15 a.m. to 2:00 p.m.)
04. Do you have a valid California Driver's License (or an out of state license and are willing to obtain a California Driver's License upon offer of employment)? Options: Yes | No
05. How many years of verifiable job related work experience do you have performing a variety of custodial activities? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1 - 2 years | 3 - 4 years | 5 years or more

06. How many years of verifiable job related work experience do you have maintaining buildings and adjacent grounds areas? Options: None | Less than 1 year | 1 - 2 years | 3 - 4 years | 5 years or more

07. According to the job announcement, check the box that most closely matches your level of proficiency to perform the minimum qualifications listed: Cleaning up blood, vomit or other unpleasant things which may have a strong odor. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

08. Performing minor building maintenance. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

09. Unplugging toilets and sinks. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

10. Using machinery such as carpet shampooer, vacuum, high/low speed buffer. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

11. Using chemicals and cleaners that require safe handling. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

12. Using proper methods of storing equipment, materials and supplies. Options: No ability to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Limited ability and experience to apply this knowledge in work-related situations. | Proficient and experienced in applying this knowledge in work-related situations.

13. The questions below are designed to indicate whether you are willing to perform the duty listed. Check YES if you are willing to perform this duty or NO if you are not. Please keep in mind that all of the duties listed are REQUIRED of the position. If you are not willing to do any one of the duties listed, you will not be considered in the recruitment process. Select "YES" to indicate that you have read and understand these instructions. Options: Yes
14. Operate machinery such as shampooer, vacuum, buffers, pressure washers, etc. Options: Yes | No
15. Wash toilets, sinks, urinals, mirrors in lavatories/restrooms and kitchen areas. Options: Yes | No
16. Collect trash from various areas and haul trash to dumpsters. Options: Yes | No
17. Sweep and mop floors in lavatories/restrooms and other areas. Options: Yes | No
18. Clean up vomit, blood, urine and other unpleasant bodily fluids. Options: Yes | No
19. Stand, reach, bend and stoop while washing walls, woodwork, doors, glass, etc. Options: Yes | No
20. Regular exposure to fumes, dust, cleaning agents, chemicals and odors. Options: Yes | No

Perform routine custodial activities at an assigned District school site during a day or evening shift; sweep, scrub, mop, wax and polish floors; vacuum rugs and carpets in classrooms, offices, workshops and other work areas; spot clean and shampoo carpets. Clean classrooms, cafeterias, lounges, offices and other facilities as assigned; dust and polish furniture and woodwork; empty waste receptacles spot mop spills; remove gum, debris and graffiti as needed. Clean and disinfect drinking fountains and restroom facilities including sinks, toilets and urinals; fill dispensers with towels, soap, toilet paper and other items; clean mirrors, tile and windows; unclog drains and toilets. Perform deep cleaning of floors as part of an assigned roving work crew as assigned; travel to school sites; strip, wax and pressure wash floors; perform routine maintenance and repairs on assigned equipment; conduct emergency maintenance and custodial duties and respond to broken sewer lines, security issues, deliveries, fires, alarms, furniture moving, equipment repair and other issues. Pick up paper and other debris from school grounds, walkways and areas adjacent to school facilities; sweep concrete surfaces adjacent to school building. Replace light bulbs and tubes, clean boards and erasers and empty pencil sharpeners; clean tables, chairs and floors after breakfast, lunch and recess periods as assigned. Lock and unlock doors and gates as appropriate; maintain security of assigned areas according to established guidelines; set alarms as appropriate; raise and lower flags as assigned. Perform a variety of routine general maintenance and repair to equipment and furniture as assigned. Report safety, sanitary and fire hazards to appropriate authority; report need for maintenance repairs to appropriate authority; respond to emergency custodial requests as needed. Operate custodial equipment such as vacuums, mops, small hand and power tools, buffer/scrubber machines and other equipment as assigned.

Move and arrange furniture and equipment; prepare classrooms and multi-purpose rooms for special events or meetings; set-up and assemble chairs, tables and other furniture and equipment for special events and activities; clean up furniture, equipment and debris following these events. Participate in the thorough cleaning and restoration of campus facilities during vacation periods. Perform minor grounds maintenance duties as assigned. OTHER DUTIES: Perform related duties as assigned. KNOWLEDGE AND ABILITIES: KNOWLEDGE OF: Proper methods, techniques, materials, tools and equipment used in modern custodial work. Modern cleaning methods including basic methods of cleaning floors, blackboards, carpets, furniture, walls and fixtures. Proper methods of storing equipment, materials and supplies. Requirements of maintaining District buildings in a safe, clean and orderly condition. Appropriate safety precautions and procedures. Proper lifting techniques. MSDS reporting procedures and requirements. ABILITY TO: Perform routine custodial activities at an assigned school site. Maintain District buildings and adjacent grounds in a clean, orderly and secure condition. Perform deep cleaning of floors as part of an assigned roving work crew as assigned. Use cleaning materials and equipment in a safe and efficient manner. Operate a variety of custodial equipment. Maintain tools and equipment in clean working order. Move and arrange furniture and equipment for meetings and special events. Observe and report safety hazards and need for maintenance and repair. Perform minor non-technical repairs. Understand and carry out oral and written directions. Observe health and safety regulations. Meet schedules and time lines. WORKING CONDITIONS: ENVIRONMENT: Indoor and outdoor work environment. Regular exposure to fumes, dust and odors. Driving a vehicle to conduct work as required by position. PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a variety of custodial equipment. Walking or standing for extended periods of time. Seeing to perform custodial duties. Carrying, lifting, pushing or pulling moderately heavy objects. Bending at the waist, kneeling or crouching. Reaching overhead, above the shoulders and horizontally. Climbing ladders and working from heights to replace light bulbs. HAZARDS: Exposure to cleaning agents and chemicals. Working on ladders. Ewing Consulting, Inc. August 2016
